summary: The Division of Highways explains that right-of-way negotiations were suspended in March 1973 pending completion of the Final EIS, and notes that the City of Milwaukee School Board's interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for land taken from Hamlin-Garland School will be investigated.
text:
Right of way negotiations and acquisition were stopped in March 1973 until this Final EIS is completed and approved.
The City of Milwaukee School Board has expressed interest in the undeveloped parcels along Parnell Avenue as compensation for the land taken from Hamlin-Garland School. This will be investigated by the Division of Highways.
opening_anchor: Right of way negotiations and acquisition were stopped in March 1973 until this Final EIS is completed and approved.
closing_anchor: This will be investigated by the Division of Highways.
